name: What flooring options are best for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What flooring options are best for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental properties, durable and low-maintenance flooring options are ideal. Popular choices include luxury vinyl plank (LVP) due to its water resistance, durability, and aesthetic versatility, mimicking wood or tile. Laminate flooring is another cost-effective option, offering good scratch resistance. While hardwood can be attractive, it requires more maintenance and can be prone to damage. Carpeting is suitable for bedrooms but generally not recommended for high-traffic areas or areas prone to spills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable and low-maintenance options like luxury vinyl plank (LVP) and laminate are often best for rental properties due to their longevity and ease of care.
